requirements:
# Automated Filling Line Control

- **Difficulty:** Easy (easy)

## Requirements

An automated filling line responsible for cleaning, filling, capping, and packaging bottles. Each step of the production line is controlled by PLC and triggered by signals from sensors and operators.
Control requirements:
When the sensor bottleSensor detects a bottle, it triggers the start of the cleaning pump and continues to work.
After cleaning is completed, the operator operates the button cleaningConfirmButton to trigger the cleaning completion signal, automatically starting the filling valve for filling.
After filling is completed, the operator operates the button fillingConfirmButton to trigger the filling completion signal, automatically starting the capping machine for capping.
After capping is completed, the operator operates the button cappingConfirmButton to trigger the capping completion signal, starting the packing machine for packaging.
After packaging is completed, the operator operates the button packingConfirmButton to trigger the packaging completion signal, lighting up the packaging completion indicator light.
After the operator picks up the packaged bottle, they press the confirmation button finishedButton to reset the indicator light and prepare for the next bottle's production cycle.

## Interface Definition

| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `bottleSensor` | `BOOL` | The bottle reaches the sensor, triggering a signal when a bottle is detected |
| Input | `cleaningConfirmButton` | `BOOL` | Operator confirmation button, used to confirm the completion of the cleaning process |
| Input | `fillingConfirmButton` | `BOOL` | Operator confirmation button, used to confirm the completion of the filling process |
| Input | `cappingConfirmButton` | `BOOL` | Operator confirmation button, used to confirm the completion of the capping process |
| Input | `packingConfirmButton` | `BOOL` | Operator confirmation button, used to confirm the completion of the packaging process |
| Input | `finishedButton` | `BOOL` | Operator confirmation button, used to confirm that the bottle has been picked up |
| Output | `Pump_Motor` | `BOOL` | Control output for the operation of the cleaning pump motor |
| Output | `Filling_Valve` | `BOOL` | Control output for the operation of the filling valve |
| Output | `Capping_Machine` | `BOOL` | Control output for the operation of the capping machine |
| Output | `Packing_Machine` | `BOOL` | Control output for the operation of the packing machine |
| Output | `Completion_Light` | `BOOL` | Indicator light for packaging completion |

scan_semantics: At scan k, inputs I[k] are sampled once, q[k] is pre-scan retained state, outputs O[k] are observed after execution, and q[k+1] is the updated state. Each test creates a fresh FB instance before step 0. An initialized instance has not yet executed a scan. Timer elapsed time is zero on the first eligible sampled invocation; dt_ms is elapsed wall time since the previous invocation, not automatically a synthetic input to the FB. No unobserved past input stability is assumed. All sequences here are expected values.
safety_priority: Active phase restricts which confirmation can be accepted.
Only the current phase actuator may run.
assumptions: The five process actuators are mutually exclusive; each completed phase switches off its actuator when the next starts.
One phase transition at most is allowed per scan. Confirmation signals outside their active phase are ignored.
Confirmation inputs are level sampled. A held confirmation can complete its relevant phase on a later scan, but cannot skip several phases in one scan.
finishedButton resets only the completed phase. A bottle still present can start a new cleaning cycle on the following idle scan.
For the progress property, future confirmations are ordered and sustained until their matching phase accepts them. Unordered one-scan pulses do not imply completion.
The specification_contract is normative and supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.

ltl.explanation: A fresh instance is idle with outputs off before first execution.

ltl.formula: G((phase=1 & G((phase=1) -> F(cleaningConfirmButton)) & G((phase=2) -> F(fillingConfirmButton)) & G((phase=3) -> F(cappingConfirmButton)) & G((phase=4) -> F(packingConfirmButton))) -> F(Completion_Light))
ltl.explanation: Conditional progress: from cleaning, if every active phase eventually receives its matching confirmation, completion eventually occurs.
The complete per-invocation relation defined in specification_contract.normative_completion; requires explicit encoding before model checking.

atomic_propositions.phase: Ghost pre-scan state 0 idle, 1 cleaning, 2 filling, 3 capping, 4 packing, 5 complete; phase is updated once per scan.
atomic_propositions.oneHotOutputs: At most one of Pump_Motor, Filling_Valve, Capping_Machine, Packing_Machine, Completion_Light is TRUE.
atomic_propositions.init: Before the first scan, phase=0 and all outputs FALSE.
atomic_propositions.all variable names: The identically named sampled input or end-of-scan output in interface.
atomic_propositions.CompleteBehaviorV2: 独立定义nextPhase：0有瓶→1，否则0；1清洗确认→2，否则1；2灌装确认→3，否则2；3旋盖确认→4，否则3；4包装确认→5，否则4；5取瓶确认→0，否则5。每拍只用旧phase选择一个分支。补G(X(phase)=nextPhase)，并逐一规定Pump_Motor↔nextPhase=1、Filling_Valve↔2、Capping_Machine↔3、Packing_Machine↔4、Completion_Light↔5；其余全部为假。初始phase=0作为独立初值条件。

tests.purpose: Full bottle cycle and stable completion

specification_contract.observation: I[k] is sampled before execution; O[k] is observed after execution. Initial conditions apply before invocation zero.
specification_contract.normative_completion: 独立定义nextPhase：0有瓶→1，否则0；1清洗确认→2，否则1；2灌装确认→3，否则2；3旋盖确认→4，否则3；4包装确认→5，否则4；5取瓶确认→0，否则5。每拍只用旧phase选择一个分支。补G(X(phase)=nextPhase)，并逐一规定Pump_Motor↔nextPhase=1、Filling_Valve↔2、Capping_Machine↔3、Packing_Machine↔4、Completion_Light↔5；其余全部为假。初始phase=0作为独立初值条件。
specification_contract.history_binding: Every previous-output name refers to the preceding observed output with the declared initial value. Previous-input memories update on EVERY invocation, including reset, invalid input, stop and mode change. Reference phase/history is independently advanced from sampled inputs by the stated transition rules, never supplied by the candidate.
specification_contract.evaluation_scope: Properties include interpreted data predicates. No claim of export to a model checker or completed formal proof.
